summary: This class examines the order of parashiot in tefillin according to Rashi, Rambam, and Rabbeinu Tam. It discusses the practice of wearing Rabbeinu Tam tefillin in Aleppo and in recent times. The lesson references Siman Lamed Dalet in Shulchan Aruch and writings from rabbis including Chaim Abraham Antebi, Chaim Abraham Hamwe, Yitzhak Shahebar, and Moshe Tawil.
